successor.$comment: GTF-D14, see FINDINGS_V2.md and SYSTEM.md. Supersedes D13. enabled false.
successor.selection: learned score >= train 90th pct OR the five hand rules

model.target: percent return under stop 2 ATR / target 8 ATR / 60-bar cap
model.refit: every quarter on trades resolved >=95 days earlier

execution.stop: entry - 2.0 * ATR14 on the fill day
execution.target: entry + 8.0 * ATR14 on the fill day

successor.honest_summary: lower raw return than buying the index, materially better risk-adjusted return, near-zero correlation with it. A diversifier, not a replacement. Roughly half of the first headline figure was an illiquidity tilt that was removed.
successor.largest_unexplored_gain: the short side - supply zones are detected but untested

measured_last_two_years_2024_09_04_to_20.note: capacity is the binding failure: signals arrive in selloff bursts, slots fill on the way down with the early poor trades in the cluster, and the good trades arrive with no capacity left. The 21.3% CAGR in SYSTEM.md covers 2022-2026 and is front-loaded.

recommended.$comment: GTF-S7. The video's own 7/7 trade score, with a volatility stop instead of the video's distal stop. Beats both GTF-D14 and buy-and-hold over the last two years. See FINDINGS_V2.md section 11. enabled false.
recommended.selection: GTF trade score == 7/7 (fresh, >=2 leg-outs or 1+gap, 1-3 base candles)
recommended.correction: FINDINGS.md called the GTF score inversely predictive. That held only with the video's distal stop, which sits inside the noise on a thin zone. With a 2 ATR stop the inversion disappears and 7/7 is the best bucket. The score works; the stop placement does not.
recommended.do_not_add: the EMA200 filter - it raises per-trade quality to +4.71% and cuts the portfolio to +7.2%

s1_s4_verdict.$comment: From 210,409 ungated signals regenerated with the look-ahead-fixed engine. See FINDINGS_V3.md section 2.

existing_score.correction: the strong inversion the audit reported was contamination; after the fix the score is simply flat across most of the range, though 90-100 is the worst band in both held-out periods
existing_score.conclusion: gating at 85 selects worse than taking everything - delete the gate

replacement_score.method: 35 fingerprint features, gradient boosting, refit quarterly on past data only
replacement_score.conclusion: anti-predictive out of sample; S1-S4 signals are not rankable by these features. Do not ship a replacement score.

what_does_separate_them.recommendation: trade S4 only; S1, S2 and S3 have lost money for two years

exit_change_avg_pct_full_window.note: changing the exit is worth more than any scoring change available

user_proposal.why: cuts the average winner from +18.4% to +13.7%; with 33 winners paying for 67 losers the tail is what pays
user_proposal.note: beats the baseline on the portfolio because it holds 14 bars instead of 24 and slots are the binding constraint

recommended.why: 83.8% of trades that reach +3% and 71.3% of those that reach +5% dip back to breakeven and mostly recover; by +15% only 26.6% do, so the move is nearly free

allocation_experiments.throttles_tested: max 2/3/5 new per day, 25-40% dry powder, rank by width/ATR/leg-out, index above 20d MA

index_above_20d_ma.note: destroys the edge - the strategy needs the selloff

combining_gtf_and_s4.conclusion: they compete for the same slots and S4 displaces better GTF trades; uncorrelated is not enough when capacity is the constraint - separate books would be needed
